title: OTLP batched reassembly and latency synthesizer for inference KPIs
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Inference telemetry from edge/dedicated hosts arrives as fragmented OTLP batches and Prometheus push metrics with variable label schemas. This causes high cardinality, incomplete per-request KPI assembly, and spurious latency spikes in dashboards when partial traces or missing KV cache annotations prevent correct attribution.

Goal: Build a resilient reassembly layer that ingests OTLP metric spans and Prometheus push data, performs deterministic batched reassembly (re-ordering, dedup, sampling reconciliation), synthesizes missing latency components for per-request KPIs, and emits a stable, tenant-aware time-series and event stream for the dashboard and SLO pipelines. The component should preserve trace hooks and link back to spans/trace IDs where available for linkability in the APM.

Success criteria:
- Reassembled per-request KPI stream with >=99.5% attribution rate for requests that include any identifiable ID (request_id, trace_id, or connection_id).
- Reduced dashboard noise: false-positive latency spikes from incomplete samples down by 90% in first-week post-rollout.
- End-to-end ingestion throughput >= 40k request KPI/sec for a standard tenant on staging without degradation.

Scope and constraints:
- Support OTLP metrics/protobuf and Prometheus push gateway inputs used by Dedicated nodes and edge sidecars.
- Deterministic ordering within 30s ingestion window; late-arrival window configurable up to 5 minutes.
- Tenant-aware merging and cardinality control (prefix canonicalization + schema tags).
- Must emit both Prometheus-friendly metrics (for existing dashboards) and OTLP envelopes (for downstream SLO processors).

Approach:
1) Frontdoor adapter: unified OTLP/prom-compat endpoint with lightweight admission control and per-tenant buffering.
2) Reassembly engine: micro-batches keyed by canonical request identity; re-order using arrival timestamps and sequence hints, run dedup and merge label sets; synthesize missing latency segments (e.g., kv_cache_lookup, model_queue_wait, decode_time) using heuristic models when trace spans are absent.
3) Trace linking: when trace_id/span_id present attach mapping metadata and emit span-level anchors for the APM to correlate request KPIs with full traces.
4) Backends: emit consolidated Prometheus metrics (histogram buckets + exemplars) and OTLP metric envelopes with stable metric names and low-cardinality label sets.
5) Observability and testing: end-to-end harness, synthetic workloads, and comparison job against gold-standard trace-linked ground truth.

Trade-offs considered:
- Heuristic synthesis vs dropping incomplete data: synthesis preferred to avoid downstream SLO blindspots, but heuristics must be conservative and flag low-confidence samples.
- Latency vs completeness: configurable reassembly window; default tuned for 30s to balance dashboard freshness and attribution completeness.
- Complexity: avoid heavy per-tenant state by leveraging bounded window caches and tombstones; longer-term work may migrate to sharded state stores.

Rollout plan:
- Stage 0 (staging-only): adapter + no-op reassembly; validate throughput and schema transformations. (2 days)
- Stage 1 (shadow): run reassembly in shadow mode in prod ingest path, emit metrics to a side pipeline and compare to existing dashboards. (1 week)
- Stage 2 (gradual): enable reassembly for 5% tenants with read-only dashboards; verify regressions. (1 week)
- Stage 3 (default): flip for all tenants with rollback knob and increased retention for debugging. (1 week)

Acceptance criteria:
- Matching job shows attribution >= 99.5% for test traces with partial arrivals.
- Dashboards show 90% reduction in noise on the latency/error page for controlled test tenants.
- No >5% increase in CPU usage for ingress fleet at expected load profile.
- Automated regression test added to the telemetry CI validating canonicalization and exemplar preservation.

Deliverables:
- New service: telemetry-reassembler (k8s manifest + helm chart).
- Schema docs: canonical label mappings and synthesized-latency fields.
- Dashboard updates: latency/error dashboards to use the consolidated KPI metrics and confidence label.
- RFC + Confluence design doc + performance report.

comments: 2026-02-19: Kickoff sync with infra and runtime teams. Agreed on 30s default reassembly window and 5-minute late arrival cap. -- Aisha

2026-02-25: Architecture review: Concluded we should emit both OTLP envelopes and Prometheus histograms to avoid rewriting dashboards. Still need to finalize exemplar preservation approach. Action: Liam to prototype exemplar mapping. -- PM feedback from Serena Gomez

2026-03-02: Prototype showed correct ordering for simulated out-of-order batches but high memory for pathological tenant. Decided to add bounded LRU + eviction policy and surface metrics when evictions occur. -- Eng review

2026-03-05: Design review with Security: confirmed no sensitive payloads are stored; retained keys limited to request_id/tenant/trace_id; retention TTL set to 7 minutes. Security review not required per current policy. -- Security
2026-03-07: Shadow run started for two internal tenants. Early signal: attribution went from 86% -> 98% for our test traces. Observed small increase in CPU; tracking under metrics. -- Liam
